## Summary

**Issue:** `checkout-api` was failing health checks after the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an error rate of 0.18.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Investigated** — `get_service_status` confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all regions; `list_deployments` showed the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was older, and v2.3.1-rc was a staging build).
2. **Opened SEV2 incident** — Created incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy"), which paged the on-call engineer.
3. **Rolled back to v2.3.0** — The first rollback attempt partially failed (halted after us-east due to an orchestrator error), leaving us-west and eu-west still on the unhealthy v2.3.1. I retried the rollback, which completed successfully.

**Final state (verified):** `checkout-api` is now on **v2.3.0** in all three regions, **healthy**, with error rate back down to 0.002.

Note: the unhealthy v2.3.1 remains the latest release in the deployment history, so it should not be re-promoted until the underlying issue is investigated.
